entries.196548d7f7b538ab: A reportable segment in which mainly Anicom Parfait Co., Ltd. develops and sells oral and intestinal care products keyed to various tests, aiming to prevent disease through daily oral and intestinal care. Ordinary revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥573 million (up 65.8% year on year), the smallest of the 4 reportable segments. The segment loss was ¥308 million (compared with a loss of ¥132 million in the previous fiscal year). The securities report states that it began selling the periodontal disease prevention toothpaste gel "CRYSTAL JOY", "7Days Food", which increases the diversity of intestinal flora, and "CARE PUREE", which supports the meals of pet dogs and cats, and is developing sales channels. From the current consolidated fiscal year, this business is presented as a reportable segment.
entries.1b1c5b6e7eed00ec: A reportable segment in which Anicom Advanced Medical Research Institute, Inc. conducts research, clinical work and development for basic research in veterinary medicine, establishing evidence-based treatment methods, and developing preventive and advanced medicine, and also takes over hospitals to support regional veterinary care and operates animal hospitals itself. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, ordinary revenue from external customers was ¥2,401 million (up 10.7% from the previous year) and segment loss was ¥717 million (a loss of ¥28 million in the previous year). The securities report states that "JARVIS Animal Medical Center Tokyo," opened in Minato-ku, Tokyo in October 2025, provides advanced animal medical care centered on secondary care and night-time emergency treatment, and aims to be a growth base supporting everything from prevention to advanced medical care through case accumulation and group collaboration.

entries.fee03b875c73f364: This reportable segment is one in which the subsidiary Anicom Insurance, Inc. carries out insurance underwriting and asset management for pet insurance, and it is the Group's core business. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, ordinary revenue from external customers was ¥65,817 million (up 8.8% from the previous year) and segment profit was ¥4,797 million (¥5,602 million in the previous year); of the 4 reportable segments, it has the largest ordinary revenue from external customers. Policyholders pay premiums, and the insurance pays medical costs when 15 types of pets, including dogs and cats, receive treatment for illness or injury; it is characterized by a "window settlement system," in which only the self-paid portion is paid at the veterinary hospital counter. The securities report states that new policies were 266,231 (up 8.3% year on year) and policies in force were 1,392,772 (an increase of 104,849 from the end of the previous year, up 8.1%). Policyholders enroll through agencies such as pet shops (as of the end of March 2026, 1,352 pet shop agencies and 384 general agencies) and through the Web and other channels.
